research_question: When group count and features per group are varied independently, can stage-1 and stage-2 accumulation effects on Q.ANT numerical discrepancy be separately identified?
hypothesis: A factorial design will reveal independently measurable stage-1 and stage-2 accumulation effects, resolving the confounding exposed by Exp026.
falsification_criterion: The hypothesis is weakened if independently changing feature width does not alter stage-2 discrepancy in a reproducible way or if stage-local effects remain inseparable.
limitations: CPU backend only; no photonic hardware performance claim.
Factorial grid is bounded rather than exhaustive.
